KN.investment_route: donation (SISC) or real estate (400000 USD, 7yr hold)
KN.due_diligence: mandatory interview; biometric enrolment since Apr 2026
KN.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds, medical exam
KN.key_benefits: visa-free/on-arrival to 150+ destinations incl. UK, Schengen, Hong Kong, Singapore; no personal income, wealth, or inheritance tax; oldest CBI program (est. 1984)
KN.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
KN.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit documents and undergo due diligence; make investment on approval; receive certificate and passport

AG.investment_route: donation (NDF) or real estate (300000 USD) or business (1500000 USD)
AG.due_diligence: standard due diligence, interview for high-risk cases
AG.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
AG.key_benefits: visa-free to 150+ destinations incl. UK, Schengen, Hong Kong; one of the cheapest options for a family of 4
AG.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
AG.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit documents; pay NDF or complete real estate purchase; interview if required; oath of allegiance within 5 years

DM.investment_route: donation (EDF) or real estate (200000 USD, 5yr hold)
DM.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds, medical exam
DM.key_benefits: lowest-cost CBI program; visa-free to 140+ destinations incl. UK, Schengen, Hong Kong, Singapore
DM.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
DM.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit forms and documents; due diligence review; make donation or real estate investment; receive certificate and passport

GD.investment_route: donation (NTF) or real estate (270000 USD, 5yr hold)
GD.path_to_citizenship: n/a (citizenship granted directly); qualifies for US E-2 treaty visa
GD.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
GD.key_benefits: only Caribbean CBI with US E-2 treaty visa eligibility after 3 years' domicile; visa-free to 140+ destinations incl. China, UK, Schengen
GD.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
GD.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit application and documents; due diligence by CBI Unit; make investment; receive certificate and passport

LC.investment_route: donation (NEF) or real estate (300000 USD) or enterprise (3500000 USD) or government bond (300000 USD)
LC.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
LC.key_benefits: widest range of investment routes among Caribbean CBI programs incl. interest-free government bond; visa-free to 140+ destinations
LC.taxation_notes: no tax on worldwide income, capital gains, or inheritance
LC.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit application; due diligence by CIP Unit; select investment route and pay; receive certificate and passport

TR.investment_route: real estate (3yr hold) or bank deposit (500000 USD)
TR.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, appraised investment value maintained for hold period
TR.key_benefits: fastest large-economy CBI option; E-2 treaty eligibility for US investors; visa-free/on-arrival to 110+ destinations
TR.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in Turkey (183+ days); otherwise no obligation on foreign income
TR.application_steps: select qualifying real estate or open bank deposit; obtain conformity certificate; apply for citizenship; biometric appointment

VU.status: active, under periodic EU visa-suspension scrutiny
VU.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
VU.key_benefits: fastest CBI program globally (30-60 days); no income, capital gains, or inheritance tax; visa-free to 90+ destinations
VU.taxation_notes: no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax
VU.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit documents; due diligence by Vanuatu Citizenship Office; pay contribution; receive certificate and passport

MT.program_name: Naturalisation for Exceptional Services by Direct Investment (MEIN)
MT.physical_presence_requirement: 1 or 3 years residence required before application
MT.due_diligence: four-tier due diligence, among the strictest globally
MT.family_inclusion: spouse, children up to 29, parents over 55
MT.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, extensive source-of-wealth verification, in-person residence
MT.key_benefits: EU citizenship (when active) gave visa-free/settlement rights across all EU/EEA states; program is currently not accepting new applications
MT.taxation_notes: EU tax residency rules would apply if resident; non-dom regime available separately
MT.application_steps: program suspended; no new applications currently accepted pending Maltese government response to CJEU ruling

MT.investment_route: government contribution plus property purchase (375000 EUR) or rent (14000 EUR/year)
MT.physical_presence_requirement: none to maintain residency; property held 5 years
MT.family_inclusion: spouse, children, parents, grandparents (up to 5 generations)
MT.path_to_citizenship: no direct path; separate naturalisation route by ordinary residence
MT.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds, health insurance
MT.key_benefits: EU-adjacent residency and Schengen travel; no minimum stay requirement; property held only 5 years
MT.taxation_notes: non-doms taxed only on Malta-source income and remitted foreign income
MT.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit application to Residency Malta Agency; pay contribution and secure property; due diligence; residence card issued

EG.investment_route: bank deposit or treasury bond (250000 USD) or real estate (300000 USD)
EG.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
EG.key_benefits: only North African CBI program; access to Egyptian passport for regional travel and business
EG.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in Egypt; foreign-sourced income of non-residents generally untaxed
EG.application_steps: submit application through Ministry of Interior channels; complete investment; security clearance; citizenship decree

JO.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds; naturalised citizens barred from public office for 10 years
JO.key_benefits: access to Jordan's stable Levant/Gulf business environment; free-trade agreements with EU, US Qualifying Industrial Zones
JO.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in Jordan
JO.application_steps: apply via Jordan Investment Commission; choose deposit or enterprise route; Cabinet and royal approval required

NR.program_name: Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program
NR.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
NR.key_benefits: funds climate resilience and relocation infrastructure; visa-free access incl. Hong Kong, Singapore, UAE
NR.taxation_notes: no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax
NR.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit documents; due diligence by Nauru Program Office; make Treasury Fund contribution; receive certificate and passport

ST.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds; open to all nationalities except North Korea
ST.key_benefits: cheapest CBI program globally; fully remote application, no interview or residence requirement
ST.taxation_notes: no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or inheritance tax
ST.application_steps: choose licensed agent; submit documents; due diligence by CIU; make donation; receive certificate, passport, and national ID

PT.investment_route: cultural donation (250000 EUR) or fund units (500000 EUR)
PT.physical_presence_requirement: 7 days year 1, 14 days per subsequent 2-year period
PT.path_to_citizenship: citizenship after 10 years residence (7 years for EU/CPLP nationals)
PT.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, valid health insurance, verifiable source of funds
PT.key_benefits: access to Schengen Area; low physical presence requirement; established path to EU citizenship
PT.taxation_notes: non-habitual resident tax regime available for qualifying new residents
PT.application_steps: choose investment route; obtain NIF and bank account; submit AIMA application; biometrics appointment; residence permit renewal every 2 years

GR.investment_route: real estate, 250000-800000 EUR depending on region
GR.path_to_citizenship: citizenship after 7 years residence plus language/integration test
GR.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
GR.key_benefits: access to Schengen Area; no minimum stay to maintain residency permit; real estate can be rented for income
GR.taxation_notes: non-resident investors generally taxed only on Greek-source income
GR.application_steps: select qualifying property; obtain Greek tax number; submit residence permit application; property registration; biometrics

ES.key_benefits: program discontinued; other investor and non-lucrative visa categories remain available separately
ES.application_steps: real estate route no longer accepts new applications as of April 2025

IT.investment_route: innovative startup (250000 EUR) or company (500000 EUR) or government bonds (2000000 EUR) or philanthropic donation (1000000 EUR)
IT.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
IT.key_benefits: access to Schengen Area; flat tax regime available for new residents on foreign income
IT.taxation_notes: optional flat annual tax on foreign-sourced income for qualifying new residents (regime forfettario)
IT.application_steps: apply for nulla osta clearance online; obtain investor visa at consulate; complete investment within 3 months of entry; apply for residence permit

CY.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, proof of stable annual income from abroad
CY.key_benefits: fast processing; minimal physical presence; EU-adjacent lifestyle
CY.taxation_notes: non-dom regime exempts foreign dividends and interest from tax for qualifying residents
CY.application_steps: purchase qualifying new-build property; submit application with proof of income; interview; permit issued

HU.investment_route: real estate fund (250000 EUR) or direct property (500000 EUR) or donation to higher education (1000000 EUR)
HU.path_to_citizenship: no direct path; separate naturalisation route by ordinary residence
HU.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
HU.key_benefits: 10-year renewable residence permit; access to Schengen Area; relatively low entry threshold for EU residency
HU.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in Hungary
HU.application_steps: choose investment route; submit application to National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing; due diligence; residence permit issued

LV.investment_route: real estate plus one-time state fee (~5 percent)
LV.path_to_citizenship: no direct path; separate naturalisation route by ordinary residence
LV.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
LV.key_benefits: access to Schengen Area; relatively low property investment threshold among EU programs
LV.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in Latvia
LV.application_steps: select qualifying property; pay state fee; submit application to Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs; residence permit issued

AE.path_to_citizenship: no path to citizenship (exceptional cases only, not investment-based)
AE.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
AE.key_benefits: 10-year renewable residency, longest-duration golden visa; no personal income tax; sponsor own dependents and staff
AE.taxation_notes: no personal income tax; no capital gains tax on personal investment property
AE.application_steps: select qualifying property; apply via ICP or GDRFA portal; biometrics and medical test; Emirates ID issued

US.investment_route: targeted employment area (800000 USD) or standard (1050000 USD); must create 10 jobs
US.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable lawful source of funds, must create/preserve 10 full-time US jobs
US.key_benefits: direct path to US green card and eventual citizenship; no sponsor or job offer required, unlike other US visas
US.taxation_notes: US tax residents taxed on worldwide income once green card is issued
US.application_steps: file Form I-526E petition; conditional green card on approval; file Form I-829 after 2 years to remove conditions

PA.investment_route: real estate, securities, or bank deposit
PA.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
PA.key_benefits: fast processing; territorial tax system exempts foreign-source income; permanent residency granted directly (not renewable temporary status)
PA.taxation_notes: territorial tax system: foreign-sourced income not taxed
PA.application_steps: select investment route; submit application to National Immigration Service; due diligence; permanent residence card issued

SG.investment_route: business expansion or fund investment, selective/invitation-based
SG.due_diligence: extensive due diligence, high rejection rate
SG.path_to_citizenship: citizenship route by ordinary residence, selective
SG.eligibility_criteria: proven entrepreneurial or business track record, substantial verifiable net worth, business plan review
SG.key_benefits: access to Singapore's business and financial hub status; permanent residency granted directly if approved
SG.taxation_notes: worldwide income not taxed; only Singapore-source and remitted income taxed for residents
SG.application_steps: submit business/fund proposal to EDB; interview and evaluation; approval in principle; complete investment; PR granted

BR.investment_route: business investment (500000 BRL) or passive real estate (1000000 BRL)
BR.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds, registered investment plan
BR.key_benefits: lowest-cost investor residency among major economies; access to Mercosur trade bloc region
BR.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in Brazil (183+ days)
BR.application_steps: register investment plan with relevant agency; apply for visa at Brazilian consulate or in-country; residence permit issued

NZ.investment_route: growth investment category; higher threshold for balanced category
NZ.physical_presence_requirement: minimum days vary by investment category
NZ.path_to_citizenship: permanent residence and citizenship via ordinary residence route
NZ.eligibility_criteria: proven business/investment experience, verifiable source of funds, English language ability
NZ.key_benefits: relaunched 2025 with lower thresholds and shorter minimum stay than prior program; strong rule of law and quality of life
NZ.taxation_notes: worldwide income taxed if tax-resident in New Zealand; no capital gains tax on most personal investments
NZ.application_steps: submit Expression of Interest; obtain approval in principle; make qualifying investment within 12 months; visa granted

PY.eligibility_criteria: 18+, clean criminal record, verifiable source of funds
PY.key_benefits: low entry threshold; one of the fastest South American residency-by-investment options; territorial tax system
PY.taxation_notes: territorial tax system: foreign-sourced income not taxed
PY.application_steps: select qualifying tourism project; submit application to Ministry of Industry and Commerce; permanent residence granted
